text: It's six fourteen in the morning. You're in the barn, taking care of the animals.
Across the field, half a mile away, something moves.
You step outside. Someone is running near the fence.
Then you see the movement clearly. Too stiff. Too fast.
The person ahead falls. More figures emerge from the grass.
The cattle bunch together. Your phone suddenly lights up.
Emergency alert. Remain indoors. Avoid physical contact with anyone showing extreme aggression or confusion.
Across the valley, more signs appear. You turn back toward the house.
Something is moving nearby. Keep walking. Don't run.
